description: Index of all relevant features, classes, entities, components, and contracts defined in the GPWCF Primary Architecture Public API domain documents. Links are relative to this index file location.

records.name: Public API Architecture (Wave 6 Artifact 3)
records.description: Wave 6 detailed design (artifact 3) defining the stable, supported consumer-facing Public API surfaces of GPWCF Core and the optional Prefect Integration, including what consumers may implement/customize/compose, how they invoke Stage, how optional Supporting Patterns are accessed, and how Prefect-specific binding is used without exposing private implementation paths.

records.name: Core Public API Surface
records.description: Core Public API (PUBLIC-CORE) with namespace gpwcf.public_api.core; owner: GPWCF Core; availability: Always available, no Prefect dependency; exposes Stage/Step/SPU callable and result contracts.

records.name: Prefect Integration Public API Surface
records.description: Prefect Integration Public API (PUBLIC-PREFECT) with namespace gpwcf.public_api.integrations.prefect; exposes Prefect-specific binding/configuration/correlation/result retrieval API groups without exposing private wrappers or native metadata internals.

records.name: Public API Governing Decision Principle
records.description: Public API is the stable supported consumer contract boundary; it is not merely an __init__.py re-export list or a convenient alias for internal modules; public symbols are explicit, curated, versioned, and tested.

records.name: Stage Callable / Stage Invocation / Stage Result Contract Group
records.description: Core Public API contract group covering StageCallable, StageInvocation, and StageResult; readiness gaps resolved according to Waves 1-4.

records.name: Step Invocation / Step Execution Result / Optional Result Contributions Contract Group
records.description: Core Public API contract group covering StepInvocation, StepExecutionResult, and OptionalResultContributions; readiness gaps resolved according to Waves 1-4.

records.name: Generic SPU Result Types Contract Group
records.description: Core Public API contract group covering generic SPU result types; SPUExecutionResult[TOutput] remains distinct from StepExecutionResult.

records.name: Canonical Identities Contract Group
records.description: Core Public API contract group covering canonical identity value types; provided through core.identities module as narrow dependency-free nominal identity types.

records.name: Optional Diagnostics Public Sub-Surface
records.description: Optional Diagnostics public sub-surface under Core Public API; core.diagnostics module is optional and does not become a universal Error Model.

records.name: Supporting Pattern Public Sub-Surfaces
records.description: Separate Supporting Pattern public sub-surfaces under Core Public API; Validation, Observation, and Error Handling patterns remain separately importable and opt-in.

records.name: Prefect Binding API Group
records.description: Prefect Integration Public API group exposing supported Prefect-specific binding contract; no Prefect imports or types in Core Public API.

records.name: Prefect Configuration API Group
records.description: Prefect Integration Public API group exposing supported Prefect configuration contract; configuration ownership held by integration package.

records.name: Prefect Correlation API Group
records.description: Prefect Integration Public API group exposing supported Prefect correlation contract; domain/native identity correlation preserved without conflating namespaces.

records.name: Prefect Result Retrieval API Group
records.description: Prefect Integration Public API group exposing supported result retrieval contract; persisted Stage domain results retrieved separately from Prefect State.

records.name: Optional Import Guarantees
records.description: Optional import guarantees defined for Supporting Patterns and Diagnostics; consumers that do not select optional patterns incur no mandatory import; internal module paths have no consumer compatibility guarantee.

records.name: Public Symbol Curation
records.description: Public symbols and imports are explicit, curated, versioned, and tested; no wildcard re-exports; internal modules kept outside public_api packages.

records.name: Compatibility / Versioning Policy
records.description: Public API compatibility and versioning policy defines stability guarantees across version changes; every public symbol has a source contract/design owner and versioning classification.

records.name: Public API Conformance Tests
records.description: Public API conformance tests verify supported exports, not private imports; tests validate public API manifest matches exported __all__ symbols, module ownership maps to Framework_Module_Boundary_Model, no duplicate public identity/result type under multiple internal packages.

records.name: Consumer Implementation / Specialization Points
records.description: Defines what consumers may implement, customize, compose, and invoke; consumer owns Pipeline Root (no generic Root API created); consumer-specific Generator Stage/Step Models or business contracts excluded from Public API.

records.name: Stage/Step/SPU Invocation and Typed Result Contracts
records.description: Stage/Step/SPU invocation and typed result contracts match detailed designs in Waves 1-3; Stage, Step, and SPU callable/result signatures align with Wave 1-3 detailed designs.

records.name: Required Governing Artifact Changes - Dependency_and_Public_API_Architecture
records.description: Update Core Public API contract groups to include StageCallable/StageInvocation/StageResult, StepInvocation/StepExecutionResult/OptionalResultContributions, generic SPU result types, and canonical identities; add optional Diagnostics and separate Supporting Pattern public sub-surfaces; update Prefect Integration API to binding/configuration/correlation/result retrieval contract groups.

records.name: Required Governing Artifact Changes - Filesystem Architecture
records.description: Allocate explicit public_api/core and public_api/integrations/prefect source packages; allocate documented optional public sub-surfaces for identities, diagnostics, and Supporting Patterns; keep internal modules outside public_api and do not wildcard re-export them.

records.name: Required Governing Artifact Changes - Framework Module Boundary Model
records.description: Add MOD-CORE-IDENTITIES and MOD-CORE-DIAGNOSTICS modules; map each Public API surface/sub-surface to its logical module owner; keep consumer and Prefect Integration ownership boundaries separate.

records.name: Change Control / Implementation Gate
records.description: Wave 6 Public API proposal; becomes supported consumer contract only after architecture review, governing-artifact reconciliation, and implementation conformance tests; do not create public_api package files or export symbols until six-wave design set and governing PHASE-03 artifacts are reconciled and accepted; next step: cross-wave consistency review of all six waves.
